notes.title: RHYTHMIC Joins VRForever!
notes.content:
VRForever!!
We are super excited to participate in the first ever VRForever Steam event! 

130 participating games

From today Sept. 18th to 23rd

Deep discounts

New demos and releases

First-ever VRForever Awards - 30 nominated games in 6 categories



It's gonna be wild! Here we goooo.. 


Wishlist RHYTHMIC or play the demo for free now!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2.0
notes.content:
Right in Time for VRForever 
As we are approaching the VRForever Steam Event on Sept. 18. we wanted to make sure to get this out to everyone in time!

We are super excited to participate and happy to be part of this great and quickly growing VR community on Steam!


New:
DEMONS! New minions have come to besiege the people of Dengshi Valley!

There is a proper pause menu and score/lose screen available now in game from which the session can also be abandoned or restarted!

The map of the tutorial has been completely remade. It now takes place directly inside the sanctum of the Prime Sorceress!


Improvements:
You can now cancel dialogues of Drog and Bog in the main menu

The controller feedback when collecting mana is increased now

Several smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Hotfix V0.4.1.2
notes.content:
Improvements:
Switching between leaderboards is much faster now

Made credits spawn as full text which is faster and more efficient

Reduced non-visible foliage in main menu for performance gains


Bug Fixes:
Hand poses were incorrect

Fixed infinitely respawning credits menu globes


Polish
Fixed that some particles in the main menu portal activation were just hanging in the air

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.4.1.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes[olist]
Implemented support for names with Japanese, Korean, and Chinese characters which were previously not displayed at all in the leaderboards. ごめんね, 미안해, 对不起.

The enrage mechanism for the monster enemies works correctly again.

Improved performance and reduced loading times.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update V0.4.1.0
notes.content:
Dear all,
thanks so much to the early players who gave me amazingly useful feedback! I used that to improve some things in the demo. 

This update brings the following changes:


Changes:[olist]
Added coloured halos around enemies to show which magic types they have a weakness towards (receiving 2.5x damage from that magic type)

Reworked the enemy spawning algorithm which is much more robust, leaner and makes it much easier to control enemy spawn probabilities in a data driven fashion

Reworked the introduction tutorial! Made it shorter and incorporated the new halo system

Improved visibility of enemies by increasing their contrast towards the environment

Some performance optimisation

Reduced the range of the earth spell so it shoots roughly as far as the other spells when using similar force
[/olist]

Bug Fixes:[olist]
Fixed a bug where player sometimes received more damage than intended from shooters on higher difficulties

Some internal menu bugs
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.4.0.1
notes.content:
Changes[olist]
Increased strength of assisted throwing in Easy difficulty

Raised earth spell slightly from the ground to make it more visible
[/olist]
       
Bug Fixes[olist]
Menus show their names now as intended

Hands close completely when grabbing magic spells
[/olist]
